adapter_notes: Demographics join uses patient, encounter and culture-order keys; it has no time column.
Age is a categorical range followed by years, for example 25-34 years.
Gender uses anonymous codes and literal Null missing markers.
Ward includes the culture-order timestamp plus four binary ward flags.
No separate hospital identity is present in the verified core files.
Keep all IDs as strings to avoid numeric coercion and precision loss.
